channel.title: The Sun Media Corporation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Sun Media Corporation (thesundaily.my)

item.title: Fresh blasts rock Gulf capitals as Iran conflict escalates
item.description: Explosions and smoke reported in Dubai, Doha and Manama following a day of deadly Iranian missile and drone strikes across the region.

item.title: Penang police arrest four over mall slashing attack
item.description: Four suspects are remanded as police probe a violent assault at a Jalan Kelawai shopping mall, with investigations focusing on a possible business dispute.

item.title: Middle East airspace closures may disrupt flights, warns CAAM
item.description: CAAM warns of potential flight disruptions to and from the Middle East due to airspace closures, advising passengers to check with airlines directly.

item.title: Malaysia stands with Muslims, communities hit by West Asia conflict
item.description: Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim expresses solidarity with Muslims and communities affected by US and Israeli attacks on Iran, calling for peace and stability.

item.title: Trump threatens Iran with unprecedented force if it retaliates
item.description: Former US president Donald Trump warns Iran of overwhelming retaliation if it responds to strikes that killed its supreme leader.

item.title: MMEA detains tanker for illegal anchoring in Kemaman waters
item.description: A tanker was detained by maritime authorities for anchoring without permission during a special security patrol in Terengganu.

item.title: Public urged to trust police in Quran desecration probe
item.description: YADIM calls for calm and legal process following viral Quran incident, urging public to avoid vigilantism and inflammatory social media posts.

item.title: AFC postpones Middle East club matches after US, Israel strikes
item.description: Asian Football Confederation reschedules Champions League Elite and other knockout matches in West Region due to security concerns following strikes on Iran.

item.title: Malaysians in Qatar urged to stay home amid regional instability
item.description: Malaysia's embassy in Doha advises citizens to stay vigilant, avoid non-essential travel, and monitor official updates as Qatar's airspace remains closed.

item.title: MARA to strengthen role in Bumiputera progress after 60 years
item.description: Deputy Prime Minister Ahmad Zahid Hamidi says MARA will enhance its mission to empower Bumiputera youth for global competitiveness as it marks six decades of service.
